title: The Borrowed Typewriter
author: M. M. Joubert
blurb: Yara Nakamura, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
